summary: Narrative room graph, dialogue, inventory item combinations, flags, journal and chapter save/load.
useWhen: Create another narrative chapter, inspect item/inventory combination rules, or study the authority as a snapshot-batch consumer of shared bounded ingress.
limitations: Item/flag rules and replay-validated saves are chapter-specific, not a general inventory or arbitrary game-state save system.
Only the SDK command queue is genre-neutral: capacity 128, action validation and save/load/reset ordering remain Story policy.
